title: norite automation --json
description:
The machine-readable output of `norite automation enable`, `disable` and `status` (M22): how the daemon's port for scripts stands.

Versioned source of truth (CLAUDE.md rule 15): a change to what these commands print ships with a change to this file in the same commit. Every field is always present.

The port's secret is in none of it, and no command prints it. `norite automation run` prints nothing of its own: the program it starts takes its place. `norite automation request` prints the instance's JSON answer to the request it made, which is described by openapi.yaml and not here, with what a terminal would act on escaped as \uXXXX; it prints nothing when the instance sent no body.

status.description: How the port stands, after the command.

enabled.description: Whether the port is turned on. It is off until `norite automation enable`.

port.description: The port on 127.0.0.1 it is on, or would be on.

instance.description: The instance it was turned on for, the only one it serves, or empty when it is off.

open.description: Whether the daemon is listening. On and not open is a port that could not be bound when the daemon started; `problem` says why.

address.description: Where it listens, or empty when it is not open.

problem.description: Why a port that is on is not open, or empty.
